purpose: Create one source-distinct but behavior-compatible accepted-main successor so the canonical Release Set Build can naturally publish immutable Release Set B for the real FC-6 staging A-to-B-to-A rehearsal.

required_preconditions: candidate branch is based on exact accepted main source of durable Release Set A
only this non-authoritative evidence-only intent differs from accepted main
all applicable exact-head PR workflows are completed/success
all protected required contexts are completed/success on the exact candidate head
guarded squash merge is bound to the exact candidate head

post_merge_requirement: Treat the accepted successor source as B only after its ordinary main push produces a directly observed canonical immutable Release Set v2. Do not infer B publication from merge success alone.
